sections.name: bodyToHtml
sections.title: Plain text to HTML
sections.what: Turns plain text into a simple HTML email, escaping ampersands and angle brackets and splitting paragraphs at blank lines.
sections.why: Email clients expect HTML, and escaping keeps text from being read as markup.
sections.watch_out: Quote marks are not escaped, which is fine in normal text but would matter if this text were placed inside an HTML attribute.

summary: Sends one email through the Resend email service, using a key and sender details supplied in the request, and wraps the plain text in simple HTML.
purpose: Lets the app send outreach emails.
why: Likely reason: lets the user send applications or messages from their own address.
how: Reads the message fields, converts the body to HTML, takes the subject, and sends it through Resend. The subject extraction and the main handler were not included in the packet.
inputs: Recipient, subject, body, Resend key, sender email, optional sender name, and optional reply-to address.
outputs: A send result or an error. Not fully visible in the packet.
risks: The Resend key is sent in every request body. No login check is visible, so anyone who can reach this route could send email through it. Sending cannot be undone.
debug: Check the Resend key and sender address in the Resend dashboard. Check the HTML that bodyToHtml produces.
